title: SAST
brief: **Ticket:** add static scanning to the pipeline. Run a scanner and name what it finds.
theory:
## SAST
Reads source without running it, flags risky patterns (source -> sink). Tools: **Bandit** (Python), **Semgrep** (multi-language). Fast, runs in CI, has false positives.
worked_example:
```
$ bandit -r app/
>> Issue: [B602] subprocess with shell=True ... Severity: High
```

investigation.intro: Run the mini scanner (and the real Bandit via tools-lab) on the vulnerable code.
steps: It reports the vulnerability class on the shell=True line.
hints: The scanner prints the class in CAPS.
